referenceComposition: AM
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: A loaded AvatarImage requires meaningful alt. This reference fallback uses explicit role=img and the same full name, while initials and badge color alone are insufficient. Nearby text supplies the person and availability independently.
updatesAndDescendants: Avatar uses Base UI loading states idle/loading/loaded/error. AvatarImage onLoadingStatusChange reports the actual status; keepMounted=false preloads and only exposes a loaded image. keepMounted=true retains the image while loading but hides it from accessibility until loaded. Fallback span defaults delay=0 and is shown when not loaded after its delay; a positive delay avoids flashing. Source/srcSet/sizes changes retry loading. Root has no activation or selection API. AvatarGroup/Count only position caller content; counts and status are not calculated.
referenceDecision: The full fallback name, readable Available badge and nearby identity text are explicit reference composition choices. The root does not automatically apply role=img or label initials. If adjacent text fully identifies the person, a decorative avatar can instead have empty alt deliberately.

naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
protocol: Source-normalized observations project real internal image/scroll state, derived progress, caller-owned upload props or the composed Collapsible protocol. No generic activation callback is invented. Internal lifecycle observations are not public Root events.

root.description: Actual portrait root with public size.

image.description: Loaded native image; alt is caller meaning.

fallback.description: Fallback content mounted by primitive lifecycle; named image role belongs to this caller.

badge.description: Small visual badge, with status conveyed separately as ordinary text.

group.description: Actual group layout, optional caller grouping/name.

status.description: Caller-owned readable status outside the visual badge.

count.description: Passive visible overflow count, not an invented action or size API.
